points.point: What's wrong with the body (URL and schema mismatch)
points.sentence: Legacy POST /v2/videos/creations uses a template object and a different schema. Current POST /v2/videos/from-templates uses templateId and inputs.

points.point: Which endpoint to send templateId and inputs to
points.sentence: Use its complete ID in templateId and send the matching body to POST /v2/videos/from-templates.

verdict.reason: The customer sent a current-style body (templateId and inputs) to the legacy /v2/videos/creations endpoint, which expects a template object. This entry explains that mismatch and names the endpoint to use.
